title: Voyah Music 0.2.6
notes:
- Send tracks with Voyah Music Transfer while the Android phone shares its internet connection with the car over Wi-Fi.
- Updated player layout for wide and compact head-unit displays, with library controls grouped next to the track list.
- Separate Mazda EZ-6 build with its own app ID (`app.mazdaez6music.player`) and in-app update asset.

Use **MazdaEZ6Music-v0.2.6.apk** on the Mazda EZ-6, **VoyahMusic-v0.2.6.apk** on Voyah, and **VoyahMusicTransfer-v0.2.6.apk** on the Android phone. Transfer works with both head-unit builds. Back up local music before replacing any debug build that uses a different signing certificate.
